chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Make A
exercises.purpose: Land the A shape (middle of the neck).

params.fingers: index(1) B 2nd? correct: index(1) on B-string 2nd, middle(2) on G 2nd, ring(3) on D 2nd
params.open_strings: A and high-e ring open; low E muted

exercises.coaching: A: index on the B string second fret, middle on the G second, ring on the D second. Low E stays quiet, A and high e ring. A compact, movable little shape.

exercises.name: Rotation with A
exercises.purpose: Add A↔D and G↔A to the rotation.
exercises.coaching: Add A: A to D, G to A. Keep rotating the whole set. The more pairs you can switch without stopping, the more songs open up.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: A is a small, tidy shape in the middle of the neck. Add it and your change vocabulary nearly doubles.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: A: index on B second fret, middle on G second, ring on D second. Low E quiet. A and high e open. Tiny triangle of fingers.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Rotate with A in the mix: A-D, G-A, plus your older pairs. One chord per four beats. Stop the pause, keep the pulse.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Five chords now. The combinations are multiplying — you are a few lessons from hundreds of songs.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: A is in. Next lesson: Am, and the "big four" plus Am is the set that unlocks thousands of songs.
